The right lower lobe contains a large cystic structure with thin walls. The remainder of the lungs are clear without focal consolidation, pleural effusion, or pneumothorax. The cardiomediastinal silhouette is normal.

The lungs are hyperinflated. There is a large cavitary lesion in the right upper lobe with thick irregular walls. The remainder of the lungs demonstrate emphysematous changes. No pleural effusions are seen.
